008package paint.shared.utils;
009
010/**
011 * Provides centralized access to runtime configuration parameters
012 * such as verbosity and log level.
013 * <p>
014 * This class loads and persists its configuration using {@link PaintPrefs}
015 * and maintains thread-safe static access to global runtime flags.
016 * </p>
017 */
018public final class PaintRuntime {
019
020    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
021    // FIELDS
022    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
023
024    private static boolean verbose;
025
026    /**
027     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
028     */
029    private PaintRuntime() {
030        // Deliberately left blank
031    }
032
033    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
034    // INITIALIZATION
035    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
036
037    /**
038     * Initializes runtime settings by loading stored preferences.
039     * <ul>
040     *   <li>{@code verbose}: whether verbose logging is enabled
041     *       (default {@code false}).</li>
042     *   <li>{@code logLevel}: current log level string
043     *       (default {@code "INFO"}).</li>
044     * </ul>
045     * <p>
046     * Should be called once during application startup.
047     * </p>
048     */
049    public static void initialiseFromPrefs() {
050        verbose  = PaintPrefs.getBoolean("Runtime", "Verbose",   false);
051        //logLevel = PaintPrefs.getString ("Runtime", "Log Level", "INFO");
052    }
053
054    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
055    // ACCESSORS
056    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
057
058    /**
059     * Checks whether verbose mode is currently active.
060     *
061     * @return {@code true} if verbose logging is enabled; otherwise {@code false}
062     */
063    public static boolean isVerbose() {
064        return verbose;
065    }
066
067    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
068    // MUTATORS
069    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
070
071    /**
072     * Enables or disables verbose logging and persists the new value to preferences.
073     *
074     * @param v {@code true} to enable verbose logging; {@code false} to disable
075     */
076    public static void setVerbose(boolean v) {
077        verbose = v;
078        PaintPrefs.putBoolean("Runtime", "Verbose", v);
079    }
080}
